title: Sampling logit equilibrium and endogenous payoff distortion
abstract: arXiv:2603.09539v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce sampling logit equilibrium (SLE) for population games in which agents infer payoffs from a finite sample of $k$ opponents' actions and respond according to a logit choice rule. We find that sampling error systematically distorts incentives. Actions whose inferred payoffs are relatively more variable earn a variance premium, while nonlinear payoffs generate a curvature premium through Jensen effects. For large samples, an SLE is approximated by a logit equilibrium of a virtual game whose payoffs include these premiums. For linear games, when sampling error and logit noise vanish at comparable rates, their interaction around completely mixed Nash equilibria is reduces to a Gaussian--Gumbel limiting model. We also establish exact finite-$k$ uniqueness and stability results. In particular, in two-action coordination games with a $1/k$-dominant action, the unique SLE converges to the risk-dominant equilibrium as logit noise v

translated_title: 采样逻辑均衡与内生收益扭曲
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.09539v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们为群体博弈引入了采样逻辑均衡（SLE），其中博弈者从对手行动的有限样本（大小为k）中推断收益，并根据逻辑选择规则作出响应。我们发现采样误差会系统性地扭曲激励。推断收益相对波动较大的行动会获得方差溢价，而非线性收益则通过詹森效应产生曲率溢价。对于大样本，SLE可通过一个虚拟博弈的逻辑均衡来近似，该虚拟博弈的收益包含这些溢价。对于线性博弈，当采样误差和逻辑噪声以可比速率消失时，它们在完全混合纳什均衡附近的相互作用简化为高斯-冈贝尔极限模型。我们还建立了精确的有限k唯一性和稳定性结果。特别是，在具有1/k主导行动的双行动协调博弈中，随着逻辑噪声消失，唯一的SLE收敛于风险主导均衡。
tldr: 本文提出采样逻辑均衡（SLE）概念，揭示了采样误差如何通过方差和曲率溢价系统性地扭曲收益，并建立了大样本近似、极限模型及有限样本下的唯一性和稳定性结果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces sampling logit equilibrium (SLE), revealing how sampling error systematically distorts payoffs through variance and curvature premiums, and establishes large-sample approximations, limiting models, and finite-sample uniqueness and stability results.
